checks.text: The page heading is "Class Timetable" and the default view is the week grid showing the days "Monday" through "Friday" with no class blocks visible.

In the "Add class" form, typing "Math" in the field labelled "Class name", selecting "Monday" in the select labelled "Day", typing "09:00" in the field labelled "Start time", typing "10:00" in the field labelled "End time", and clicking the button "Add class" adds a block in the Monday column containing the text "Math" and "09:00–10:00".

After adding "Math" on Monday 09:00–10:00, clicking the tab "Table" shows a table with a row containing "Math", "Monday", "09:00", and "10:00"; clicking the column header "Class name" sorts the table so "Math" appears in the first row.

In the "Add class" form, typing "Physics" in "Class name", selecting "Monday" in "Day", typing "08:00" in "Start time", and typing "09:00" in "End time", then clicking "Add class" adds a block in the Monday column containing "Physics" and "08:00–09:00"; the week grid now shows two blocks in the Monday column.

In the week grid, clicking the block containing "Math" opens a detail panel with a button "Delete class"; clicking "Delete class" removes the "Math" block from the Monday column, leaving only "Physics" visible in that column.

In the "Add class" form, typing "Chemistry" in "Class name", selecting "Tuesday" in "Day", typing "11:00" in "Start time", typing "12:00" in "End time", and clicking "Add class" adds a block in the Tuesday column containing "Chemistry" and "11:00–12:00".

With "Math" (Monday 09:00–10:00) and "Chemistry" (Tuesday 11:00–12:00) added, clicking the button "Export ICS" copies an ICS string to the clipboard that contains the lines "SUMMARY:Math" and "SUMMARY:Chemistry".

In the "Add class" form, typing "Bio" in "Class name", selecting "Monday" in "Day", typing "10:00" in "Start time", and typing "09:00" in "End time", then clicking "Add class" shows the message "End time must be after start time" and adds no block.
Reload keeps the class "Physics" on Monday 08:00–09:00 visible in the week grid after the page is reloaded.
